issue:
UUID scalar doesn't handle invalid values properly

Description

When passing an invalid value to a UUID scalar field, the GraphQL API doesn't properly validate the input and fails with an unhandled exception instead of returning a proper GraphQL error.

For example, if I try to pass a dictionary instead of a valid UUID string:

```
query Test($uuid: UUID){ uuid(input: $uuid) }
```

With variables:
```
{
  "uuid": {"not": "a string"}
}
```

Instead of getting a proper GraphQL error message, the server crashes with an unhandled exception. 

The UUID scalar should properly validate all input types and return appropriate error messages when invalid values are provided, similar to how other scalar types work.
